lesson.title: Writing a letter of application
lesson.title_ar: كتابة رسالة التقدّم لوظيفة (الصحيفة الجديدة والمجلة الشبابية)

lines: 3.11 3.12 A business letter
Write a business letter in answer to this job advertisement in the Daily News of April 20th.
Fantastic Job Opportunity!
Have you ever wanted to work on a newspaper?
We are looking for young men and women to train as reporters and photographers for a new general interest magazine for people under 25.
No experience is necessary but the successful applicants must be willing to work hard and already have a wide range of interests.
Write and tell us all about yourself and why you think we should give you the chance to join our exciting team.
Write to: The Editor, The Daily News, PO Box 0055, London S18 9HP
content.caption: Fantastic Job Opportunity! — The Daily News advertisement (PB page 24)

blocks.edu_note_html: ملاحظة استخراجية (600 DPI): إعلان Fantastic Job Opportunity! مضمّن كصورة في الكتاب ولا يستخرجه pdftotext؛ قد قُرئت كافة سطوره والعنوان البريدي (PO Box 0055, London S18 9HP) بصرياً عبر pb24_opp_sharp.png بدقة 600 DPI.

lines: When writing a letter of application, you must sell yourself, that is, you must give as much interesting information about yourself as you can.
Answer these questions:
• Which school subjects do you like most? Why?
• What interests or hobbies do you have? Give details. If you like music, say which music and why; if you play sport, say which sport and why.
• Have you ever had any work experience? What was it?
• Have you done anything connected with the job itself? What was it?
• Have you travelled? Where to, when and why?
• Do you have any ambitions? What are they?
Remember!
• Lay out your letter correctly.
• Refer to the advertisement.
• Ask for an interview.
• Keep the letter short, but do not miss out anything important.
• Use the correct form of address.

interactive_spot.label: الربط بين التخطيط اللفظي وتنسيق الأجزاء العشرة للرسالة

simple_explain.html:
1. صيغة المخاطبة والختام (Form of address): بما أن المرسَل إليه هو The Editor (دون ذكر اسمه الشخصي)، استعمل التحية Dear Sir or Madam, أو Dear Sir,، فتتعين معها الخاتمة Yours faithfully,! (وليس Yours sincerely).
  2. الإشارة إلى الإعلان: اذكر وظيفة التدريب (trainee reporter / photographer)، اسم الصحيفة (the Daily News)، وتاريخها (April 20th) والتاريخ التالي في الترويسة (مثلاً April 22nd).
  3. التسويق للنفس (Sell yourself): قدّم أمثلة ملموسة بدل الصفات المبهمة — فبدلاً من I like sport قُل مثلاً I play football for my school team أو اذكر عملك في مجلة المدرسة والتصوير.

example.html:
Model Body Paragraph (Box 6):
I am 18 years old and in my final year at secondary school. My favourite subjects are English and History because I enjoy reading and researching events. In addition, I write articles for our school magazine and take photographs for the school club. Furthermore, I have travelled to Aden and Taiz with my family.

Yours faithfully.ar: ختام رسمي عند عدم معرفة اسم المرسَل إليه

activities.prompt_literal: 3.12 A Prepare the key facts for your letter to The Editor of The Daily News using the 10-box layout and PB page 24 rules.
activities.prompt_ar: تحقّق من العناصر الواجبة في رسالتك استجابةً لإعلان PB ص 24 (WB 3.12 A):

items.prompt: 2 Receiver postcode (Box 2 last line): PO Box 0055, ______
3 Formal greeting when name is unknown (Box 4): ______ (or Dear Sir or Madam)
4 Advertisement reference (Box 5): I am writing to apply for the training post advertised in the ______.
5 Target training roles: reporters and ______ for a new general interest magazine for people under 25.

hints: راجع عنوان الإعلان بالصورة، وتأكد من مطابقة Dear Sir مع Yours faithfully (لا Yours sincerely).

activities.prompt_literal: 3.12 A Write a letter of application in response to the advertisement on PB page 24.
activities.prompt_ar: ورشة كتابة رسالة التقدّم الكاملة (الأجزاء 1–10) إلى محرر صحيفة The Daily News:
activities.guidance_literal: 1 Sender address → 2 Receiver address → 3 Date → 4 Dear Sir → 5 Ref to April 20th ad → 6 About yourself → 7 Interview request → 8 Yours faithfully → 9 Signature → 10 Printed name

steps.label_ar: Boxes 1–3: عنوان المرسل (يميناً)، عنوان المستلم (يساراً)، والتاريخ (يميناً تحت عنوانك)
steps.placeholder: [Right] Al-Zubairi Street, Sana'a, Yemen | [Date] April 22nd, 2005  ||  [Left] The Editor, The Daily News, PO Box 0055, London S18 9HP

steps.label_ar: Boxes 4–5: التحية الرسمية والإشارة للإعلان والتخصص
steps.placeholder: Dear Sir,  I would like to apply for the post of trainee reporter as advertised in the Daily News of April 20th.

steps.label_ar: Box 6: التسويق للنفس (المواد، الهوايات المفصّلة، الخبرة المتصلة، السفر، الطموح)
steps.placeholder: I am 18 years old and in my last year at secondary school. My favourite subjects are English and Geography because I enjoy researching world events. I am interested in photography and have been taking photos for our school magazine for two years. Furthermore, I have visited several towns in Yemen to write short reports. One day, I hope to work as a full-time journalist.

steps.label_ar: Boxes 7–10: طلب المقابلة والختام الرسمي والتوقيع والاسم المطبوع
steps.placeholder: I look forward to hearing from you and would be grateful for the chance of attending an interview.  Yours faithfully,  [Signature]  Tariq Ahmed

hints: لا تنسَ وضع الفاصلة بعد التحية والختام، وتطبيق روابط Unit 3 مثل Furthermore / In addition / Because / Look forward to.

questions.stem: When replying to 'Write to: The Editor, The Daily News, PO Box 0055, London S18 9HP' without knowing the Editor's name, which greeting and closing pair is required by PB page 24?

options.why_wrong: تحية Dear Sir أو Dear Madam لا تجتمع مع Yours sincerely، بل توجب Yours faithfully.
الإعلان لم يذكر اسم المحرر (Jones)، ومتى ذُكر اسم شخص استُعملت Yours sincerely.
عبارة Best wishes غير رسمية ولا تطابق قواعد الرسالة التجارية في PB ص 24.

hints: اقرأ الملاحظة (Note) أعلى PB ص 24 بعناية.
غياب الاسم الشخصي = Dear Sir / Dear Madam + Yours faithfully.
questions.explain: عند توجيه الرسالة إلى صفة وظيفية مثل The Editor دون اسم شخص، نستعمل Dear Sir / Dear Madam ونختم بـ Yours faithfully.

questions.stem: According to the 'When writing a letter of application' checklist on PB page 24, what does 'sell yourself' mean?

options.text: Give as much interesting, specific information about your subjects, hobbies, experience and ambitions as you can while keeping the letter concise.
Ask immediately about the starting salary and demand a high wage.
options.why_wrong: الإعلان مخصص للتدريب ولا يركّز على المطالبة بالراتب؛ بل ينص الكتاب على شرح sell yourself بتقديم معلومات مشوّقة عنك.

options.text: Write a very long three-page essay including unrelated personal stories.
options.why_wrong: ينص قسم Remember على: Keep the letter short, but do not miss out anything important.

options.text: Leave out hobbies because employers only read school marks.
options.why_wrong: الإعلان يطلب أصحاب اهتمامات واسعة (a wide range of interests)، والصندوق يوصي بتفصيل الهوايات.

hints: انظر الجملة الأولى في الإطار الأحمر الكبير أسفل PB ص 24.
that is, you must give as much interesting information about yourself as you can.
questions.explain: يفسّر كتاب الطالب نفسه المصطلح في PB ص 24 بأنه إبراز قدراتك واهتماماتك بتفاصيل مقنعة ومختصرة.

flashcards.back: إبراز قدراتك واهتماماتك بتفاصيل مشوّقة ومقنعة لصاحب العمل مع الإيجاز

flashcards.front: do not miss out anything important
flashcards.back: لا تُغفِل / لا تُسقط أي معلومة مهمة
